facts.text: Fouquet's New York sits on Tribeca's cobblestone streets.
facts.excerpt: Nestled on Tribeca’s cobblestone streets, Fouquet’s New York channels the spirit of its iconic Parisian maison with a New York flair.

facts.text: The hotel was designed by Martin Brudnizki and blends 1930s Art Deco glamour, with brass, velvet and soft lighting, with an intimate, residential feel.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Martin Brudnizki, the hotel blends 1930s Art Deco glamour—brass, velvet, and soft lighting—with an intimate, residential feel.

facts.text: Rooms and suites have high ceilings and large windows, and Martin Brudnizki dressed the interiors with pastel tones, refined materials and Art Deco-inspired furniture.
facts.excerpt: Designer Martin Brudnizki has dressed the interiors with pastel tones, refined materials, and Art Deco–inspired furniture

facts.text: The Tribeca Terrace Suite's living room opens onto a 500-square-foot terrace with panoramic views of the neighborhood's 19th-century brick buildings.
facts.excerpt: A grand living room bathed in natural light opens onto a stunning, 500-square-foot terrace with panoramic views of the neighborhood’s 19th-century brick buildings.

facts.text: Fouquet's Corner Terrace Suite has water views of the Hudson River from the bedroom, living area and terrace.
facts.excerpt: An island of serenity and elegance that seems to float above the Hudson River, Fouquet's Corner Terrace Suite enjoys water views from the bedroom, living area, and terrace.

facts.text: The Fouquet's Penthouse covers 2,432 square feet over two floors.
facts.excerpt: With a total surface area of 2,432 square feet over two floors, it offers the comfort and opulence of a spacious Parisian apartment.

facts.text: The Hudson View Corner Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows looking onto the Hudson River.
facts.excerpt: The sparkling Hudson River seems close enough to touch from the floor-to-ceiling windows lining this special Hudson View Corner Suite.

facts.text: Spa Fouquet's New York partners with Paris skincare brand Biologique Recherche to personalize treatments to each guest's objectives and needs.
facts.excerpt: Our partnership with Biologique Recherche, a cult skincare brand based in Paris, allows us to personalize treatments to each guest’s specific objectives and needs.

facts.text: The spa has a hydrotherapy pool, sauna and steam room.
facts.excerpt: Spa Fouquet's New York is our signature wellness center featuring five treatment rooms, a hydrotherapy pool, sauna, and steam room.

facts.text: Brasserie Fouquet's is an homage to Fouquet's Paris, founded in 1899 on the Champs-Elysees, reimagined in the heart of Tribeca.
facts.excerpt: In homage to Fouquet's Paris, founded in 1899 on the Champs-Élysées, the iconic Brasserie has been reimaged in the heart of Tribeca.

facts.text: Titsou Bar has candlelit tables and evokes Paris in the 1920s and '30s.
facts.excerpt: With its candlelit tables, exclusive ambience, and dazzling interiors, Titsou Bar evokes Paris in the 1920s and ‘30s.

facts.text: Le Vaux is a rooftop for hotel guests and members, located atop the eight-story hotel.
facts.excerpt: Le Vaux is a guest and members-only rooftop.

facts.text: Cannes Cinema at the hotel hosts ticketed movie screenings on a seasonal basis and is available for private rental.
facts.excerpt: Ticketed movie screenings are hosted on a seasonal basis.

facts.text: The DOGPOUND Fitness Center is open 24 hours for hotel guests and members.
facts.excerpt: DOGPOUND Fitness Center is open 24 hours for hotel guest and member use.

facts.text: The hotel is dog-friendly, welcoming dogs up to 30 pounds at no charge.
facts.excerpt: Fouquet’s New York is dog-friendly, welcoming dogs that weigh up to 30 pounds, complimentary.

facts.text: Two- and three-bedroom connecting suites are available.
facts.excerpt: We offer up to two and three-bedroom connecting suites.

facts.text: Le Vaux rooftop is seasonal and closes for the winter.
facts.excerpt: Le Vaux is currently closed for the winter season and will reopen in late May.

facts.text: Valet parking is offered for hotel guests at a daily charge.
facts.excerpt: Fouquet’s New York does offer valet parking for hotel guests only and there is no requirement to arrange services in advance.

facts.text: Deluxe King Rooms are decorated in lavender and almond green, with tall windows overlooking Tribeca's historic red brick buildings.
facts.excerpt: With its charming palette of lavender and almond green and tall windows overlooking the historic red brick buildings of Tribeca, our Deluxe King Rooms are luxurious Parisian-style havens.
